bibliography: Pagulayan, R. C., & Magbanua, F. S. (1999). Fish composition of the Pansipit River: A comparison with the first report made 70 years earlier. Transactions of the National Academy of Science and Technology Philippines, 21, 344.

primarySource.title: Fish composition of the Pansipit River: A comparison with the first report made 70 years earlier
primarySource.source: Transactions of the National Academy of Science and Technology Philippines, volume 21, page 344 (1999); one-page proceedings paper/abstract in the Biological Sciences section.

accessReview.officialVolumeText: Official NAST/DOST proceedings PDF and page-344 text reviewed through the web document viewer.
accessReview.note: The located item is the one-page proceedings paper/abstract; the underlying detailed fish table/report and voucher records were not retrieved.

abstractMethods.fieldPeriod: Monthly sampling from February through December 1998.
abstractMethods.methodLimits: No sample-level effort, species-identification method, coordinate list, voucher/catalog IDs, or season-specific species crosswalk is stated in the reviewed one-page abstract.

sourceReportedAggregates.interpretation: Historical 1998 survey aggregates exactly as reported in the proceedings abstract; not a current inventory, absence record, legal/catchability statement, or estimate of present abundance.

primarySource.sourceDescribedWaterbodyRelation: The abstract describes Palanas River as a diverging branch of Pansipit that also empties into Balayan Bay approximately 3 km from the Pansipit River mouth. This source-reported network description is not a validated channel crosswalk or boundary.

rightsReview.sourceCopyrightNotice: The official volume front matter states “Copyright 1999: Authors retain copyright to their respective papers” and that no part may be reproduced without prior permission from the copyright owner.
rightsReview.decision: Retain citation and concise aggregate facts only. Do not transcribe or republish the species-name table or other proceedings content without permission from the respective copyright holder.

localityAndIdentity.pansipit: Four source-described sites and a separate 33-species historical aggregate are attributed to the Pansipit River only.
localityAndIdentity.palanas: Added as a distinct source-named river research lead because the abstract reports a separate site, separate outlet and separate 38-species aggregate. Administrative locality beyond the Batangas/Pansipit study context and exact channel identity are not independently resolved.
localityAndIdentity.namesakeCaveat: Do not equate Palanas River with Barangay Palanas or any other Palanas-named feature without an authoritative crosswalk.
localityAndIdentity.estuary: No station is assigned to the separately modeled Pansipit River Estuary; downstream river data are not moved to the estuary.
localityAndIdentity.geometry: No coordinates, reach boundary, mouth polygon, or channel geometry adopted.

nextActions: Seek written permission from the relevant NAST proceedings authors/rightsholder or locate an independently licensed, site-resolved species source before transcribing the species table.
Resolve Palanas River channel identity and municipality with official hydrography/LGU records; keep it separate from other Palanas-named places and do not infer a route from the proceedings abstract.
If a rights-cleared species list is obtained, review the original taxonomic identifications and site assignment before creating any occurrence assertions.
Keep 1998 aggregates historical and do not transfer them to the Pansipit estuary or treat the reported migratory share as current catchability.
